title: Total Sleep Time and Epoch Conversion
alternateFormula: TST = total recording time − initial sleep latency − wake after sleep onset
lesson: With standard 30-second epochs, two epochs equal one minute. Total sleep time can be calculated from the number of sleep epochs or by subtracting wake components from the recording interval when the provided values describe the same interval.
coachBobNote: Check whether the question gives epochs or minutes. Mixing those units doubles or halves the result.
